Thus, duodenal atresia is not only the leading diagnosis but the confirmed diagnosis.

[EVIDENCE]  
- Classic “double bubble” sign on abdominal radiograph (supine and upright/cross-table lateral views) — pathognomonic for duodenal atresia.  
- Early-onset bilious vomiting since birth — hallmark of proximal small bowel obstruction.

- Clinical management plan includes nasogastric decompression and surgical referral — appropriate for mechanical duodenal obstruction.

None.
